headline: United Bank for Africa Reports 9-Month Pre-Tax Profit of N503 Billion, Down 13%
summary: United Bank for Africa Plc recorded a pre-tax profit of N502.98 billion for the first nine months of 2026, falling 13.1% year-on-year. The drop came despite growth in gross earnings and non-interest income.
why: UBA is one of Nigeria's largest multinational commercial banking institutions, operating across more than 20 African nations and international financial hubs.

impacts.name: United Bank for Africa Plc
impacts.why: UBA posted a 13.1% year-on-year decrease in pre-tax earnings for the 9-month period.
